KANYE WEST — 17 INDIVIDUAL CD MODELS

Open the numbered .glb files in Blender, Windows 3D Viewer, or another glTF 2.0 compatible 3D application. Each file is one complete, two-sided disc, with every texture embedded. No scene, floor, camera, lights or display duplicates are included.

Models are numbered 01–17 in the order of the album list in your supplied ZIP.

Each model:
- Original album cover printed onto the front, clipped to the circular label area.
- Reflective silver reverse, subtle surface wear and iridescent coating.
- Clear plastic hub, real central through-hole and chamfered edges.
- Real scale: 120 mm diameter, 1.2 mm nominal thickness, 15 mm centre hole.
- 9,216 triangles, with small surface details supplied by normal and roughness maps.

Use a viewer with environment lighting for reflections. Material appearance depends on the viewer: glTF clearcoat, transmission, anisotropy and iridescence extensions are used. These are unofficial concept labels, rather than reproductions of the original physical CD labels.

Artwork: Apple Music/iTunes links from the supplied album manifest. Donda 2 uses the streaming-edition cover from that manifest. Fine surface maps are procedural originals. No external texture downloads are needed.

CD construction reference:
https://volga.eng.yale.edu/teaching-resources/cds-and-dvds/application
